messages:
rachel: Noticing a cluster of low-volume OOMs tied to KV compaction over the last 48h. Opening this thread to convert postmortem follow-ups into tracked actions and owners.

mira: Ack. Short list: dark-launch compaction concurrency cap + abort-on-low-mem, heapshot profiling across phases, jemalloc stats, and incident telemetry backfill.

devon: I reproduced a small drift locally. Will add compact:start/stop markers and per-shard live-pages metric. Planning a repro run and flamegraphs.

oli: I'll implement a feature-flagged soft cap and an abort when host_free_pct < 10%. ETA 12h for flag + tests, then dark metrics.

sre-bot: Ticket INF-3477 created: "kv compaction OOM follow-ups" assigned to mira,devon,oli. Priority P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3477

rachel: Owners & short due dates:
- Oli: flagged soft cap + rollout plan / due 12h
- Devon: instrumentation + repro harness / due 48h
- Mira: profiling plan + backfill metrics / due 5d

devon: Repro commands:
./run_repro --qps 50 --duration 30m --trace compact --heap-profiler=sampling
scripts/collect_flame.sh --out /tmp/compact.svg

mira: I'll backfill metrics: kv.compact.count, kv.compact.concurrent, kv.compact.abort_count, kv.live_pages.p95 for 90d and add a dashboard overlay with host free memory.

rachel: Short-term alerts: fire when compaction.abort_count > 3 in 10m or host free < 8% during compaction.

oli: Status: branch pushed, unit tests green, enabling dark metrics in ~6h.

devon: Status: instrumentation PR opened, awaiting review. Need staging quota for long-run repro.

mira: Status: profiling plan posted; starting data collection tonight.

rachel: We'll use this thread for daily 1-line updates until INF-3477 is closed. If anything critical, ping me directly.
